answer: On the repaired fixture plugin tree, declared_count=4 and session-start observed_count=4 (equal=True, missing_markers=[]). Observed ids were read from HOOK-LOAD-MARKER lines in the session-start log, never from a hooks.json or hooks/ directory listing. Injecting the historical $schema key made the strict loader refuse the config (unknown_fields=['$schema']); observed_count fell to 0 and every declared hook was named as missing: ['session-telemetry', 'session-policy', 'session-canary', 'pre-tool-guard']. Removing $schema restored observed_count=4 (equal=True). Config-file listing stayed at 4 hook scripts in both states and is rejected as load evidence. An inert stub that always returns declared_count is silent in both states and therefore measures nothing. This Linux worktree has no hooks/_dispatch/manifest.json (present=True) and no resident Codex/Claude session; the subject is the shipped fixture under tools/hook_load/fixtures/plugin/. SENTINEL:IMP-0460:HOOKS-LOAD-VERIFIED

evidence.claim: Repaired session start: 4/4 declared hooks emitted load markers; missing_markers is empty.
A $schema-malformed hooks.json yields a strictly lower observed marker count; repair restores it. Config listing does not change.

implementation.evidence_rule: declared_ids come from the source manifest; observed_ids come only from session-start log markers written by invoked hooks
implementation.unknown_field_behavior: any top-level key outside {hooks, version} refuses the entire load (Codex $schema precedent: installed-looking, zero hooks)

negative_controls.description: [original kind: both-states] Copy the fixture, inject $schema, re-run session start. Observed marker count must drop; every declared id named.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0460. Did not run tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write. Did not relaunch finish-everything-close or p2-cloud-ok-deliver. Repo source hooks/_dispatch is absent on this worktree; measurement is the local session-start loader against the shipped fixture.
question: Anchor spec:11303 (plugin appears installed but hooks are unloaded). Implement a POSITIVE load probe: each hook emits a load marker the verifier reads, so installed status is never inferred from the presence of a config file. Exact question: how many declared hooks actually emit their load marker at session start, and does that number equal the declared count?

reviewer.notes: [method: Mechanical broken-state reading: inject $schema, require a strictly lower marker count with every missing id named, require restore on the repaired config, and require the listing/inert stubs to stay silent.]

tests.name: repaired session-start markers equal declared set
malformed config lowers observed; repair restores

title: Positive hook-load verification, not installed-status inference
